# @zakkster/lite-headless/combobox

createCombobox(options) -> ComboboxHandle

Single-select listbox-style combobox. Focus stays on the trigger; the listbox
uses the aria-activedescendant pattern (the trigger's aria-activedescendant
attribute names the highlighted item's id).

## Options

- open: WriteSignal<boolean>            -- external controlled mode
- defaultOpen: boolean = false
- onOpenChange(next, reason)            -- reason: 'trigger'|'api'|'escape'|'outside'|'select'|'tab'

- value: WriteSignal<any>               -- external controlled value
- defaultValue: any = null
- onValueChange(next, reason)           -- reason: 'select'|'api'

- placement: string = 'bottom-start'    -- 12 placements; same as popover.
                        -- Built-in engine also accepts RTL aliases
                        -- 'inline-start'/'inline-end' (-> left/right per anchor
                        -- direction); a pluggable positioner/floating-adapter
                        -- sees only the 12 physical placements (adapter throws).
- offset: number = 4
- flip: boolean = true
- shift: boolean = true
- boundary: 'clipping'|'viewport'|HTMLElement = 'clipping'
- positioner: (spec) -> {update, autoUpdate, destroy} = built-in engine
                        -- pluggable placement engine; see popover llms and
                        -- @zakkster/lite-headless/floating-adapter

- typeahead: boolean = true
- typeaheadTimeout: number = 500        -- ms before typeahead buffer resets
- loop: boolean = true                   -- ArrowDown at end wraps to start
- autoFocus: 'first'|'selected'|'none' = 'first'
- closeOnSelect: boolean = true
- closeOnEscape: boolean = true
- closeOnOutsideClick: boolean = true

- container: HTMLElement|null = document.body
- transition: boolean = false

- multiple: boolean = false             -- construction-time; opt into
                        -- multi-select. When true, item clicks and
                        -- toggleValue() add/remove Set membership instead of
                        -- writing a single scalar, chips render + remove the
                        -- selection, and Backspace on an empty trigger
                        -- deselects the last value. In multiple mode
                        -- defaultValue must be an array (to seed the initial
                        -- selection) or null/omitted (empty selection); any
                        -- other shape throws TypeError
                        -- 'createCombobox: defaultValue must be an array when
                        -- multiple: true'. Single-select defaultValue is
                        -- unchanged (a scalar).

## Multi-select (multiple: true)

R1 slice -- what ships now:

- has(value): boolean                   -- Set membership test
- toggleValue is multiple-only: called on a single-select combobox it throws
  `TypeError('createCombobox: toggleValue requires multiple: true')` before any
  write. has()/values() stay harmless in single mode -- has() reads false, and
  values() reads a frozen-empty [] (the shadow Set is never written).
- After destroy(), has() and values() AGREE: destroy() does not clear the
  selection Set, so has(value) answers the frozen post-destroy membership,
  matching the sealed values() snapshot (H-12 reads-freeze contract).
- toggleValue(value, reason): void      -- add/remove membership; rebuilds the
                        -- snapshot once, fires onValueChange(snapshotArray,
                        -- reason), repaints items + trigger data-count
- values(): any[]                       -- snapshot copy of selected values
- multiple: boolean                     -- the resolved flag (introspection)
- attachChip(el, value): off            -- wire a rendered chip so click /
                        -- Enter / Space / Backspace / Delete deselect `value`
- trigger paints data-count="<n>"       -- number of selected values
- keyboard: Backspace on an EMPTY trigger deselects the last value (only when
  multiple); onKey (single-select nav) is untouched -- this is a separate
  listener. Chip removal clamps the roving highlight like attachItem's off.

Storage model: ONE reused Set + a snapshot array rebuilt only on mutation
(same allocation class as the existing per-mutation signal writes). Zero
steady-state allocation per keystroke. In multiple mode value()/setValue()
still operate on the single scalar seam (untouched); the multi surface is
parallel.

DEFERRED (NOT in this slice -- do not rely on them yet): filter, loading,
onQueryChange, and any async/remote-options surface. attach items as they
arrive (already supported). Editable input filtering is out of scope for R1.

## Returned

{
    open: ReadSignal<boolean>,
    status: ReadSignal<'closed'|'opening'|'open'|'closing'|'closed'>,
    setOpen(value, reason),
    toggle(),
    value(): currentValue,
    setValue(value, reason),
    multiple,                           -- resolved flag
    values(): any[],                    -- multi-select snapshot (empty unless multiple)
    has(value): boolean,                -- multi-select membership
    toggleValue(value, reason),         -- multi-select add/remove
    attachChip(el, value),              -- multi-select chip (no-op unless multiple)
    attachTrigger(buttonEl),
    attachListbox(ulEl),
    attachItem(liEl, { value, label }),
    attachInside(el)                    -- mark external control as "inside" for outside-click
    destroy(),
    destroyed
}

## Keyboard model

trigger has focus throughout. When OPEN:
  ArrowDown / ArrowUp         move highlight (loops by default)
  Home / End                  jump to first / last
  Enter / Space               select highlighted, close (if closeOnSelect)
  Escape                      close without selecting
  Tab                         close (lets normal tab flow continue)
  <printable char>            typeahead (same-char cycles, mixed accumulates)

When CLOSED:
  ArrowDown / ArrowUp / Enter / Space    open
  <printable char>                       open + typeahead

## Slot conventions (for <lite-combobox>)

- [data-trigger]              -- the button (gets aria-haspopup="listbox")
- [data-listbox]              -- the ul/ol (gets role="listbox")
- [data-item][data-value="..."] -- each option (gets role="option", aria-selected)

## <lite-combobox> attributes

- open, value                 -- reactive, reflected
- placement, offset           -- positioning
- no-flip, no-shift           -- disable flip/shift
- no-loop                     -- disable wrap-around in arrow nav
- no-typeahead                -- disable typeahead
- auto-focus                  -- 'first' | 'selected' | 'none'
- no-close-on-select          -- keep listbox open after selection
- no-escape, no-outside       -- disable dismissal sources
- container, transition       -- same as dialog/popover

## States exposed on items

- aria-selected: 'true' when value matches; 'false' otherwise
- data-selected: present when value matches (for CSS hooks)
- data-highlighted: present on the keyboard-highlighted item
- aria-activedescendant on trigger: the highlighted item's id

## CSS contract

This primitive's painted attributes follow the canonical CSS contract
in `docs/CSS_CONTRACT.md`. See that doc for the cross-primitive
taxonomy (booleans like `data-open` / `data-disabled` / `data-loading`,
enums like `data-status` / `data-side`, ARIA pairings, host accessor
naming, and event naming).
